description: Shared Renovate preset for every Labs64.IO repository.
Each repository's renovate.json only contains: { "extends": ["github>Labs64/labs64.io-workspace"] }.
Rules live here so that a pin shared by several repositories is grouped and scheduled identically everywhere.
Any pin annotated on the line above with `# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name>`
(optionally packageName= registryUrl= versioning= extractVersion=).
Covers justfile constants (`X := "1.2.3"`), shell/env files (`X=1.2.3`, `X="${Y:-1.2.3}"`),
Dockerfile ARGs, YAML scalars (`appVersion: 1.2.3`) and commented JSON (`"helm": "1.2.3"`).
A third-party image pinned by digest in a chart's values.yaml, annotated above the key (blank and
comment lines may follow the annotation) with
`# renovate-digest: datasource=docker depName=<image> version=<tag>`. The digest wins over the
tag at render time, so the tag in the comment and the digest must move in one update: both are
captured here, next to the chart's appVersion (first manager) in the same package group.
Maven version properties that no <dependency>/<plugin> in the same repository references,
so the maven manager cannot see them: Spring Boot BOM overrides and versions that only
consumers of io.labs64:labs64io-parent use. Annotated with
`<!-- renovate: datasource=maven depName=<groupId>:<artifactId> -->` on the line above.

packageRules.description: Majors are a deliberate decision: label them so they are never merged as routine.
Internal Labs64.IO artifacts live in Labs64 Nexus; propose a new release as soon as it exists.

description: Inside labs64.io-commons the io.labs64 artifacts are the repository's own modules, all
versioned by the `revision` property. Its 0.0.0-SNAPSHOT default must never be
"updated" to a release: the version comes from the tag (-Drevision).
auditflow-api 0.1.0 was published out of sequence (before 0.0.14) and sorts above the
real 0.0.x line. Remove this rule once AuditFlow itself has released past 0.1.0.

packageRules.description: Labs64.IO Helm charts (umbrella + preflight): the deployed pin follows a chart release immediately.
First-party images are pinned by digest by the release pipeline (module-released event), never by Renovate.

description: Data-store images track the managed engine versions Terraform provisions on AWS
(the engine versions an operator's managed services run).
Only patch updates are routine; a new minor or major is an infrastructure decision.

packageRules.description: Spring Boot and the BOM overrides that ride ahead of it move as one change.

description: The overrides exist to pull security patches ahead of Spring Boot; they must stay on
the minor line Boot itself ships (Jackson 3.1.x with 2.21.x, Tomcat 11.0.x, Netty 4.2.x).
A new minor arrives with the Boot upgrade, never on its own.

packageRules.description: OpenTelemetry Python packages release together and must stay on one line.
OTel Java agent bundled into every Java image (Dockerfile ARG OTEL_JAVAAGENT_VERSION).
Cerbos PDP: chart appVersion, compose files and the policy build/validate scripts.
Platform chart and CRD pins every install path must hold in lockstep (`just check-pins`).
Kubernetes CLI toolchain (tool-versions.env and the devcontainer pins that mirror it).
GitHub Actions bumps are routine; one PR per repository.
A chart dependency bump must also bump the chart's own version, or chart-releaser skips publishing it.
